title: Suction Cup Hooks – Windproof Tent Hooks (Multipack)
descriptionHtml:
Hang things up – without drilling

It's handy to be able to hang things up in the tent, the car or at home. But you don't always want to drill holes or put up permanent hooks.

Strong grip with a suction cup

These hooks attach with a suction cup and hold firmly on smooth surfaces. They are windproof and durable and can be moved as many times as you like.

Features

  • Attaches with a suction cup – no holes
  • Holds firmly on smooth surfaces
  • Windproof and durable
  • Can be moved and reused
  • Great for tent, car and home

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
